EN → zh-Hans listing phrase examples (Focus mode scope)

Paste-ready zh-Hans should match how Chinese App Store readers describe iPhone Focus on the product page — not a word-for-word mirror of English Settings strings. AppLocale adapts these patterns to your English source:

  • Focus → 聚焦 — names the Focus feature buyers recognize from Settings (Apple UI also uses 专注模式; listing copy may use either when accurate)
  • Do Not Disturb → 勿扰 — silence and quiet-hours marketing on DND frames
  • Work Focus → 工作聚焦 — Work profile picker or schedule marketing
  • Personal Focus → 个人聚焦 — Personal profile on home-life or social app screenshots
  • Sleep Focus → 睡眠聚焦 — bedtime or wind-down schedule frames
  • Driving Focus → 开车聚焦 — auto-activate while driving callouts
  • Fitness Focus → 健身聚焦 — workout-session Focus marketing
  • Mindfulness Focus → 正念聚焦 — meditation or breathing app Focus frames
  • Focus Status → 聚焦状态 — sharing current Focus with contacts
  • Allow Notifications → 允许通知 — exception list when your app may break through Focus
  • Silence Notifications → 静音通知 — when gallery frames show silenced alert lists
  • Time Sensitive → 时间敏感 — urgent alerts that bypass Focus silence
  • Turn on automatically / Scheduled Focus → 定时开启 — schedule or location-based auto-turn-on marketing

zh-Hans Focus captions can differ idiomatically from en-US overlays when the on-screen feature is the same — avoid mirroring comma-heavy English marketing onto tight screenshot art.
